documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Selling and buying SaaS / cloud software: access, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, termination.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.hint: Date the agreement starts (YYYY-MM-DD)

terms.label: Order Date
terms.hint: Date of the order form (YYYY-MM-DD)

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.hint: Length of the subscription, e.g. 12 months

terms.label: Technical Support
terms.hint: Support the Provider gives, e.g. email support on business days

terms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
terms.hint: How long before renewal a party must give notice not to renew, e.g. 30 days

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.hint: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid in the prior 12 months

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.hint: Claims the Provider indemnifies, e.g. IP infringement by the Cloud Service

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.hint: Claims the Customer indemnifies, e.g. claims from Customer Content

terms.label: DPA
terms.hint: Data processing agreement that applies, or None

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.hint: State whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.hint: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, with service credits when targets are missed.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.hint: Length of the subscription, e.g. 12 months

terms.label: Target Uptime
terms.hint: Availability target, e.g. 99.9% per month

terms.label: Uptime Credit
terms.hint: Credit when uptime is missed, e.g. 10% of monthly fees

terms.label: Scheduled Downtime
terms.hint: Planned maintenance window excluded from uptime

terms.label: Target Response Time
terms.hint: Support response target, e.g. 4 business hours

terms.label: Response Time Credit
terms.hint: Credit when response time is missed

terms.label: Support Channel
terms.hint: How the Customer requests support, e.g. support@provider.com

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Added to an existing agreement: provider's use of AI, training on customer data, ownership of AI inputs and outputs.

terms.label: Training Data
terms.hint: Customer data the Provider may use to train models, or None

terms.label: Training Purposes
terms.hint: What the training may be used for, or None

terms.label: Training Restrictions
terms.hint: Limits on training, e.g. de-identify data first

terms.label: Improvement Restrictions
terms.hint: Limits on non-training product improvement

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: HIPAA agreement on how a business associate uses, discloses and safeguards protected health information.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.hint: The main agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated 2026-01-01

terms.label: BAA Effective Date

terms.hint: Time to report a breach, e.g. 10 days

terms.label: Limitations
terms.hint: Extra limits on use of PHI, e.g. no offshore storage, or None
